dict.string: Steno records the audio of your calls on this Mac so it can transcribe and summarise them afterwards. Audio never leaves your Mac.
Steno records your microphone during meetings so it can transcribe what you said. Audio never leaves your Mac.
Steno reads the title and attendees of the calendar event that overlaps a recording to name the meeting and its speakers.
Steno receives recordings from your paired iPhone over your local network.
